PAYMENT MODE :-
 
Online Payment : Use ERP Student Login available on pccoer.com college website.
 
D.D./Cheque Payment : Make Demand Draft or Cheque in favor of “Pimpri Chinchwad College Of Engineering & Research” Payable at Pune.
 
Cash Payment : Take challan from account section & pay cash in Indian Overseas Bank, Near Akurdi Railway Station.
 
Note : For cheque payment kindly carry more than one cheque in case of any error.
